app.title: Hawiyya
app.subtitle: Duplicate patient record decision support
app.banner: All patients in this demonstration are synthetic. Identifiers are synthetic and belong to no person. Results describe synthetic data and say nothing about any real registry.
app.advisory: Advisory software for planning and learning. Recommendations are requests to a human reviewer, never automatic actions.
app.error: Something went wrong. The data could not be loaded.
app.partial: Some parts are not available in this mode.

overview.title: Registry overview
overview.dob_default_share: Records with a suspected default date of birth

check.title: Registration check
check.intro: Type a name in Arabic, English or Arabizi with any other details you have. Hawiyya lists existing records that may be the same person, with a calibrated probability and the evidence.
check.name_latin: Name in Latin script or Arabizi
check.static_note: Static mode cannot score new input. Choose a precomputed example below.
check.none: No existing record looks like this registration.
check.failed_open: The check is unavailable. Registration continues as normal.
check.nbq_intro: One more field would settle the review most cheaply. Expected cost saved, in abstract cost units:

evidence.title: Evidence waterfall
evidence.desc: Each bar is one field's contribution to the log odds. Bars to the end side support the same person; bars to the start side argue against.

decision.pending: Decision engine arrives in the next phase

names.title: Name lab
names.intro: Enter a name to see how Hawiyya reads it: normalised form, tokens, consonant skeleton, coarse key, generator variants and collisions.
names.name: Name
names.collisions: Distinct lexicon names sharing a skeleton
names.static_note: Static mode shows precomputed examples only.
names.collision_note: A shared skeleton is moderate evidence, never proof: distinct names can collide.
